summaryForNext: All 5 changes landed across 2 commits matching plan.md's 2 rounds: Round 1 (f6b3d69, fix-root-frontend-script-invocation) restored 6 broken root package.json scripts by swapping `pnpm --filter ./frontend` for `pnpm -C frontend` (format needed a distinct fix, `pnpm exec prettier --write frontend/src/`, since prettier is a root-only devDependency not resolved via -C). Round 2 (43ea2ad, all 4 remaining changes, one shared checkpoint) cleared all 17 pre-existing TypeScript errors: Base UI Select/ToggleGroup nullability (6), react-resizable-panels API drift (4, a mechanical rename confirmed via .d.ts inspection not a version bump), recharts type-export drift (1), and 2 remaining errors (Progress indeterminate value + an unused ServerThreadRow.id field removed rather than force-cast). Checkpoint: bun run typecheck exits 0 (was 17), bun run build succeeds, bun run lint shows the same 215 pre-existing problems before/after (no regression). One process note for reflect: an initial mistake ran the real prettier --write instead of a dry --check during Round 1 verification, reformatting 174 unrelated files across frontend/ -- caught immediately via git status and reverted with `git checkout -- frontend/` before anything was staged, so no unintended changes shipped, but worth naming as a lesson (verify with --check/--dry-run first when a command's side effects aren't yet confirmed safe). QA gate: artifact-refiner remains formally retired per uar-security-deps-and-hygiene's decision record; verification was direct bun run typecheck/lint/build execution.
